CONFIDENTIAL — Harbor Cafe training

# Order intake: live training

## Why the new intake

Orders now arrive in one queue instead of three inboxes.

::: notes
Open with the before-and-after: three inboxes became one queue.
:::

## Your day in five steps

1. Open the queue
2. Claim an order
3. Check the details
4. Confirm the order
5. Close the ticket

::: notes
Walk through each step on the test environment.
:::

## The queue screen

![The order queue, with three test orders waiting](queue.png)

::: notes
Point at the claim button and the filter.
:::

## Who does what

| Role | Daily task |
| --- | --- |
| Front of house | Claims and confirms orders |
| Kitchen lead | Marks orders ready |

::: notes
Ask each role to say which row is theirs.
:::

## When something looks wrong

Use the escalation button, then tell the shift lead.

::: notes
Demo the escalation with test order T-03.
:::

## Practice

Claim, confirm and close test order T-01 on your own.

::: notes
Give everyone five minutes; check the competency list.
:::
